Regimen, steroid dose, disease stage, doxorubicin and prophylaxis timing/selection vary; no formal across-strategy/treatment comparisons possible. ASA.9versusno.8 per100cycles does not prove aspirin harm, ineffectiveness or equivalence. Lower therapeutic-anticoagulant point rate is author observation, not established optimum/prescription.
